html:
<fieldset>
  <legend>{{ question().prompt }}</legend>
  @if (question().type === 'text') {
    <textarea
      csTextarea
      [value]="$any(value())"
      (input)="change($any($event.target).value)"
    ></textarea>
  } @else {
    <cs-choice-group
      [label]="question().prompt"
      [mode]="question().type === 'multiple' ? 'multiple' : 'single'"
    >
      @for (option of question().options ?? []; track option.id) {
        <cs-choice-card
          [selected]="selected(option.id)"
          (selectedChange)="choose(option.id, $event)"
          >{{ option.label }}</cs-choice-card
        >
      }
    </cs-choice-group>
  }
</fieldset>
